fills.researcher_notes: The Russian Gazette of 15 December 2021 says the design documentation for the branch is paid for by Gazprom PJSC. That supports Gazprom as the owner of the planned pipeline, at medium since the article does not say who will hold title.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The newest dated report is the Russian Gazette article of December 2021, which said design was under way and work would start in 2023. No report of a start was found in the cited pages, and the proposal year is 2021. That is more than four years with no sign of progress, so a dormancy inference of cancelled is staged at low confidence. A search of news from 2023 on could overturn it.
